annotation.title_clean: AI, Data Protection and the Rule of Law: 2-Day Training for Judicial Operators in Rwanda
annotation.title_en: AI, Data Protection and the Rule of Law: 2-Day Training for Judicial Operators in Rwanda
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Justice, Republic of Rwanda (with UNESCO, GIZ, EU)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Global Toolkit on AI and the Rule of Law
annotation.summary_en: Rwanda Ministry of Justice news item on a two-day April training, run with UNESCO, GIZ and the EU, for 31 judicial professionals on AI, data protection and the rule of law, based on UNESCO's Global Toolkit. It covers AI risks such as bias and opacity in justice. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Training of 31 judges, prosecutors and lawyers in Kigali on AI and the rule of law
Based on UNESCO's Global Toolkit on AI and the Rule of Law
Highlights risks: bias, discrimination, black boxes, lack of accountability
Notes Rwanda has a National AI Policy and calls for clear legal frameworks and ethical guidelines
